name: GONE Fishing
short_description: GONE Fishing is a 1-8 player survival horror game where you and your friends must work together to stay alive, by fishing. The only way to survive is to keep feeding the lake’s insatiable hunger before it feeds on you. Can you satisfy the hunger... or will you become the next offering?

name: We Were Here Tomorrow
short_description: You and your partner awaken inside a mysterious Norček facility with little recollection of how you got there. Communicate, cooperate, and unravel the secrets in this asymmetrical co-op adventure. Only together will you decide the fate of Tomorrow…

name: Out of the Shadows
short_description: Out of the Shadows is a 2–4 player online co-op horror escape game. Explore unsettling locations, uncover their stories, solve cooperative and asymmetric puzzles, and survive the hostile inhabitants of places your team was never meant to enter.

name: Passage Zero
short_description: A short psychological horror experience that asks one question: are you paying attention, or just doing what you were trained to?

name: Sivers
short_description: Sivers is an RPG-roguelike with a unique style, where waves of enemies test your strategy. Use spells and build defenses, develop your hero, and fight bosses and varied foes. Victory on the first try is unlikely — every attempt brings you closer to success!

name: Bloom
short_description: A puzzle-platformer about an innocent, curious being exploring the planets of Bloom, planting seeds and sprouting flowers with its song. Sing! Use your voice and impact the ecosystem that birthed you, and become one with the cosmos.

name: THE FINALS - Season 12 Starter Pack
short_description: The Season 12 Starter Pack bundle includes: - 3 Legendary Weapon Skins - 1 Epic Season 12 Sticker - 1 150 Multibucks.

name: THE FINALS - Bog Standard Set

name: THE FINALS - Season 12 Ultimate Battle Pass Bundle

name: Deep Drift Fishing
short_description: Drop your line into the uncharted abyss! Dodge exotic aquatic fauna on your descent, snag high-value specimens on the reel-up, and survive encounters with mythical Apex predators. Upgrade your winch, harness burst nets, and unlock new oceans in this fast-paced arcade deep-sea fishing adventure.

name: I Am Your Beast - Quitting Time DLC
short_description: Remember: you're one of the good guys. Fight a shadow war in Southeast Asia in this story prequel DLC to indie hit I Am Your Beast.

name: Beatrice
short_description: You are sent to inspect an old abandoned estate before its demolition. Locals refuse to speak about the place, only whispering of a doll named Beatrice left behind. Uncover the horrible events that took place chapter by chapter, solve the mysteries, and find a way to escape. Are you brave enough?

name: A Sister's Journey
short_description: Explore a charmingly beautiful, hand-crafted pixel art world and help Violet on her journey searching for her sister. Uncover its mysteries, face its threatening foes, and run 'n gun your way through this challenging action-metroidvania - which will put your true platforming skills to the test.

name: AKIBA LOST
short_description: Thirteen years ago, six girls vanished in Akihabara in the unsolved case “The Akiba Vanishing”. Daiki Shinjo announces a live-action game based on the incident, gathering six women who embody Akihabara’s subculture. But their story begins to seep into reality. Can AKIBA LOST be finished?
reasons: 現在プレイヤー10人以上 +5

name: Random & Unfair Battlefields
short_description: Random & Unfair Battlefields is a chaotic fantasy RTS where you barely control your own army. Pick a faction, muster your forces, and issue decrees (spells) to tilt the odds in your favour. Randomly generated maps and daily events mean no two battles play out the same.

name: THE FINALS - Dead Certain Set
short_description: The Dead Certain Set includes: 1 Mythic Outfit, 1 Mythic Weapon Skin, 1 Legendary Weapon Skin, 1 Mythic Emote, 1 Legendary Charm, 1 Epic Player Card Background, 6 250 Multibucks.

name: O'BLOCK
short_description: Flip sneakers from a Chicago block all the way to billionaires. Haggle with parody stars like Kan Yay and Elon Tusk, catch fakes by the stitching, and turn a $300 shoebox into a billion. One verb: name a price. Free on October 20.

name: HENTAI CHAMELEON
short_description: "Hentai Chameleon" puts your hide and seek skills to the test! Play as a sexy anime girl, pose, and paint yourself to hide in the level's environment. short_description: Dino Dome: Tidy Up! is a cozy first-person organization game about restoring a giant indoor toy dome. Pick up thousands of colorful dinosaurs, match each one to its proper cupboard, and turn a wonderfully messy floor into a calm, complete collection.

name: Camille Queen of Chess bots
short_description: Play chess against bots with real personalities each bound by its own rules, moods, and game plans, not just a difficulty slider. Drill your openings, review every game, and climb from casual sparring to serious battles against the strong Camille engine. Fully offline.

name: Sloptoberfest

name: BONG FLIP
short_description: BONG FLIP is a fast-paced arcade game about launching, flipping, dodging enemies, and landing. Build your score, collect ridiculous skins, and see what you can survive before you crash. Flip it. Land it.

name: Thirteen Provinces · Hanren
short_description: Build a Three Kingdoms deck in this turn-based strategy card game. Battle AI, invite friends or find opponents through room matchmaking. Share the field and Strategy Points in 2v2, adapt to the seasons, and collect cards, cosmetics and stories of allies fighting side by side.

name: Swaplines
short_description: A simple, easy puzzle game: gather each color of ball onto its matching LINE. The more you play, the more the tricks click. Endless, randomly generated puzzles, and a cute little town in the background that grows with every puzzle you solve.

name: SHOGITOON
short_description: Checkmate the king or paint your way to victory! SHOGITOON combines shogi with a colorful battle for territory. Face 20 CPU characters with distinct play styles, or challenge a friend locally or online. In-game text is available in Japanese only.

name: House Rules 21
short_description: Blackjack, but every dealer plays by their own house rules. Work your way through nine dealers, each bending the rules of 21 in a different direction, build your bankroll, and unlock the modifiers, side bets, and card backs that turn a simple hand into a full run.

name: We Were Here Tomorrow: Fan Edition
short_description: The Tomorrow Fan Edition contains exclusive content for our most dedicated Explorers. Discover the art and music of We Were Here Tomorrow with the Digital Art Book, official soundtrack and exclusive wallpapers.

name: Trick or Eat
short_description: Halloween night, and the monsters are going door to door. Whoever opens up gets eaten. Defend the neighbourhood solo or with up to three friends: fight ghouls, witches and werewolves, spend your candy on upgrades, and if you fall, rise again as one of the monsters.

name: Formula Z: Controlled Dose
short_description: Build your pharmacy, manufacture unapproved Formula Z drugs, sell them on the streets or to hospitals, rob stores at night, evade the FDZ, and expand your business across four eras in this first-person pharmacy and business simulation.
